items.title: Rico Dowdle: Ten touches in return to lineup
items.description:
Dowdle carried the ball seven times for 40 yards and caught three of four targets for nine yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.description:

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Leads comeback in OT win
items.description:
